# Spar 0.7.6

**Spar 0.7.6 lets you choose how the coach teaches, and gives it a memory
that lasts through the whole session.**

## Standard or personalized teaching

- **Pick a teaching style per session.** Standard works through a topic's
  well-known problems in order and closes your gaps along the way.
  Personalized follows your gaps wherever they lead. Standard is the default.
- **Choose it where you start.** The setting is in the new-session and
  new-Track dialogs and in the toolbar's Coaching menu. You can also ask the
  coach in chat to switch.
- **New sessions remember the Track's choice** unless you pick a different one.
- **Better next steps.** The coach weighs several candidate problems before
  choosing, uses what you've already solved on LeetCode or Codeforces as a
  bridge, and connects a new idea to what you know before you start.

## A coach that remembers the session

- **One conversation per session.** The coach used to start fresh on every
  message, rereading your whole record and forgetting what it had just
  looked at and decided. It now carries on from where it left off.
- **Quicker, cheaper replies.** After the first message, the coach is only
  told what changed since your last one. Most of each request can then be
  served from the provider's cache instead of being processed again.
- **Long sessions stay sharp.** When a session gets very long, the older
  part is summarised. The summary keeps what you said, the hints already
  given and anything still open.
- **Rewinding works as expected.** Going back to an earlier message also
  rewinds what the coach remembers.

## Look and feel

- **New icon set** across the app.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.6-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.6.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.6-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.6-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.6-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch of a downloaded installer. Updates
  installed from inside Spar don't ask again.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
